name: Asteroid
description: Minor planets of varying sizes composed of rocks, metals, and even ice. Hundreds of thousands unexplored - perfect for illegal activity. Space Pirate hideouts commonly located here.
landingSpots: Military laser turret hidden in a small rocky asteroid. Power has run out.
Dense ring of asteroids surrounding a planet. Land on a small group.
Two medium asteroids joined together by six titanium pillars and metal cables.
Artificial asteroid with radar equipment. Tower hit by another asteroid.
Large asteroid, cracked in half, revealing tunnels dug by alien insects.
Ice asteroid, surface completely frozen and covered with sharp icicles.

encounters.name: CRASH SITE 125-B
encounters.text: A-1 Voyager cockpit with a Warp Drive. ROLL TECH - Success: salvage the Drive. Failure: lose 3 Energy.

encounters.name: ASTEROID CANTINA
encounters.text: Buy Stardust Soda or Zero-G Liquor. If -2 Favor Corsair: a Space Pirate confronts you. Play dice: bet any amount, roll two d10, 10 = double, two 10s = triple, no 10 = lose all.

encounters.name: THE OBELISK
encounters.text: An obsidian obelisk. Relive a memory of your past. [+2 EXP]

encounters.name: STORAGE SILO
encounters.text: Find a set of Ion Engines.

encounters.name: SPEEDER CHASE
encounters.text: 3 Edge-Worlders rob you. Lose first 2 items and half your Serum (rounding up). Chase them (ROLL GRACE on each attack while driving).

encounters.name: SMUGGLER'S PALACE
encounters.text: Owner imprisoned on an Aquarian planet 2 tiles north. Hidden safe: 100 Serum + 2 random narcobiotics.

name: Crater Moon
description: Most common type of moon. Rocky celestial bodies with thin atmosphere. Barren surface covered with large craters and impacts.
landingSpots: Giant crater, more than a hundred kilometers in diameter.
Ship docking and launch platform. Stairs covered in rust and debris.
Valley with a small lunar colony - spherical buildings connected by tunnels.
Terrain elevation with flags planted on top. Flags are unrecognizable.
A group of large geoglyphs, carved into the barren surface.
Underground entrance leading to a big room with blocks of computer servers.

encounters.name: ANTI-AIR DEFENSES
encounters.text: ROLL GRACE - Success: dodge with split S maneuver [+1]. Failure: lose 6 Hull.

encounters.name: ASTRAL CARTOGRAPH
encounters.text: Discover the location of a new planet - select unexplored hex, roll for planet type. It has two orbiting satellites.

encounters.name: METEOR FALL
encounters.text: Your character makes a wish. [+2]

encounters.name: KNOWLEDGE IS POWER
encounters.text: Medusa surveillance facility with a MASTER HACK. +3 Favor Medusa: request access. Fight guards: a Cyber-Terrorist + 2 Automaton Bots [-1 Favor Medusa]. Infiltrate: ROLL GRACE vs the Cyber-Terrorist. Obtain MASTER HACK + Data Shard.

encounters.name: COLONY POD
encounters.text: Find 1 Health Pack + 2 Terraforming Seeds.

encounters.name: LAST BREATH
encounters.text: An Android Synth dying beyond repair. Aid: give 8 Energy [+1]. Let them die: take 2 Energy Cells.

name: Nuclear Moon
description: High levels of radiation from failed terraforming or nuclear weapons. Toxic and threatening ecosystems with dangerous mutated alien life.
landingSpots: Impact crater. An unexploded nuclear warhead lies at its center.
Green mist engulfs a swamp. Creatures climb trees to avoid toxic water.
Dead forest next to a small lunar colony. All plants are wilted or rotten.
Immense cavern, walls decorated with strange mushrooms of different colors.
Destroyed nuclear plant. One reactor collapsed, core exposed.
Lake of strange purple and green oil next to an abandoned mineral refinery.

encounters.name: RED FOREST
encounters.text: A mutated Dust Wasp attacks. Nuclear mutations give it +15 Max HP.

encounters.name: NUCLEAR INCURSION
encounters.text: Facility NR-L3-0618. 15 minutes. Enter: fight a Deepworm in 3 turns or roll for Abyssal Scar. Explore with a drone: lose 5 Energy. Find: 3 Power Cells + random HACK + 2 Data Shards.

encounters.name: ACID RAIN
encounters.text: ROLL GRACE - Success: sprint to shelter [+1]. Failure: lose 6 Health.

encounters.name: LUNAR GRAVEYARD
encounters.text: Find BurnPatch + ShieldStim.

encounters.name: ABANDONED SHIP
encounters.text: Abandoned Twinrotor Hauler. Retrieve 2 Health Packs.

encounters.name: THE HUNT
encounters.text: Join the hunt: a Mutated Chimaera appears (+10 Max HP). Hunter deals d12 per turn. If not defeated in 5 turns, beast kills the hunter. Loot a Gravity Rifle from his body.

name: Frost Moon
description: Composed of ice and water. Most common celestial bodies containing water. Hard to traverse due to cold temperatures and geysers. Some have subsurface oceans of liquid water.
landingSpots: Peak of the tallest mountain in the valley. Northern lights visible at night.
Frozen skeleton of a giant alien animal. Small creatures use it as shelter.
Lone village in the tundra, on the shore of a frozen chemically active lake.
Giant mechanical crawler vehicle, abandoned over a snowy battlefield.
Ceramic shrine carved into a mountain sierra. Stone path leading to it is frozen.
Old military base, hidden in the mountainside. Large metal doors are stuck.

encounters.name: SNOWFALL
encounters.text: ROLL VIGOR - Success: grab onto a tree, avoid snowfall [+1]. Failure: lose 7 Health.

encounters.name: ALONE IN THE ARCTIC
encounters.text: Ruins rebuilt by 3 Edge-Worlders. Spend the night and restore Health and Energy to 20.

encounters.name: OPEN YOUR MIND
encounters.text: A Synth Apostle. +3 Favor Synth Arch: gain a random MASTER HACK [+1 Favor Synth Arch]. Accept: gain a random HACK [+1 Favor Synth Arch]. Reject: fight the robot [-1 Favor Synth Arch].

encounters.name: BLIZZARD
encounters.text: Find shelter in a cave. A Deepworm attacks.

encounters.name: ON THIN ICE
encounters.text: Find a broken underwater robot. Take 2 Energy Cells.

encounters.name: FROSTPEAK BASE
encounters.text: Rebel column to military base MO-S-926. -2 Favor WARG: a Guerrilla Commander attacks with 2 Rebel Soldiers. Join the expedition (less daunting). Go alone: ROLL VIGOR (+4 if with rebels). If you make it: gain random cybertech implant. If alone: also gain 75 Serum + random ranged weapon mod.

name: Volcanic Moon
description: Extreme volcanic geologic activity and high temperatures. Hundreds of active volcanoes. Rivers of lava flow through the surface, sometimes forming oceans of molten rock, iron, and sulfur.
landingSpots: Ash clouds cover the sky. Darkness broken by glowing lava lakes.
Geothermal energy plant, explosions damaged the roof of its power processor.
Lava waterfall rushing over the gorge of a mountain valley.
River of magma turned solid. Feel the ground move as you walk over it.
Crater of an inactive volcano. Center covered in metallic dust.
Shores of basalt columns surrounding a massive yellow lake of sulfur and molten rock.

encounters.name: VOLCANIC ERUPTION
encounters.text: ROLL GRACE - Success: dodge falling rocks and flames [+1]. Failure: lose 7 Hull.

encounters.name: DOME OF LIFE
encounters.text: Take the batteries: steal 3 Energy Cells, plants die. Grab the seeds: take 2 Terraforming Seeds.

encounters.name: THERMAL HALLUCINATION
encounters.text: -1 to every stat until you reach a Settlement or consume a Health Pack.

encounters.name: CASKET OF ASH
encounters.text: Find 2 Flash Rounds + 1 bottle Zero-G Liquor.

encounters.name: MELTED MINDS
encounters.text: Destroy the robots: fight 3 Android Synths, gain 95 Serum [+1 Favor ISF][-1 Favor Synth Arch]. Finish off patrol: fight 3 ISF Soldiers, gain random cybertech [+1 Favor Synth Arch][-1 Favor ISF].

encounters.name: INFERNO SHELTER
encounters.text: Find Hades IV armor set inside.

name: Hollow Moon
description: Man-made orbiting megastructures with an outer metallic surface layer and a hollow core. Interior often housed population centers or entertainment facilities, with breathable air and large gardens.
landingSpots: Small transparent moon. Rotation engine malfunctioning, nullifying all gravity inside.
Mecha building factory, an unfinished armored suit prototype sits in the mechanics bay.
Suburban neighborhood with thousands of identical housing compartments.
Cybertech company mega-store. Interior looted and ransacked.
Theme park featuring an interminable roller coaster circling the whole moon.
Hyperspeed racing track for hover vehicles. Three have crashed into the last curve.

encounters.name: FAIRY SONG ONLINE
encounters.text: Find a random HACK in a PC terminal.

encounters.name: ANDROID FACTORY
encounters.text: Defend the factory: fight a Cyber-Terrorist and a Nethacker, gain random cybertech [+1 Favor Synth Arch][-1 Favor Medusa]. Kill the androids: fight the Synth Apostle, gain random MASTER HACK [+1 Favor Medusa][-1 Favor Synth Arch].

encounters.name: GAME OVER
encounters.text: ROLL MIND - Success: delete the malware. Failure: lose 6 Fuel and 5 Energy.

encounters.name: THE SLUMS
encounters.text: Scavenge 2 random status cures from an empty home.

encounters.name: URBAN TRIBE
encounters.text: May buy any melee weapons or melee weapon mods from Edge-Worlders.

encounters.name: STARDUST INC.
encounters.text: Side with nomads: fight 2 Space Pirates. Side with pirates: fight a Looter + 2 Edge-Worlders. Win: get d6 bottles of Stardust Soda, sell for 100 Serum each or consume.
